method: Page images rendered at 110 dpi and directly inspected at readable resolution. Complete layout text for pages 2-119 also compared with the preceding reading copy.

findings.front_page: Title, sole author, affiliation, corresponding email, the 234-word abstract and seven keywords fit page 1; the expanded term is legible.
findings.introduction: Page 2 retains the introduction and the connected original-source motivation with normal paragraph and page transitions.
findings.declarations_and_bibliography: Page 99 retains the existing data/code and preparation disclosures and the start of the alphabetical numbered bibliography without overlap or clipping.
findings.last_page: Page 119 retains the complete final centered-score composition statement, equations and proof with the page number clear.

scope: Visual layout of the inspected pages and complete unchanged-body layout text; claim correspondence and source preservation are recorded separately.
